camel_example: aliyun swas-open AttachKeyPair --region cn-hangzhou --KeyPairName test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InstanceIds.1 '2ad1ae67295445f598017499dc****' --version 2020-06-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Attaches a key pair to a simple application server
description_zh: 轻量应用服务器绑定密钥对
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open attach-key-pair --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-ids '["2ad1ae67295445f598017499dc****"]' --biz-key-pair-name test --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachKeyPair

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the specified lightweight database instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the list of supported Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. You can generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and can be up to 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the simple application servers. You can specify up to 50 instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器实例ID。最多支持50个实例ID
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The name of the key pair. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with http:// or https://. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh: 密钥对名称。长度为2~64个英文或中文字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以http://或https://开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）
parameters.name: key_pair_name

FailCount.description_en: The total number of instances to which the key pair failed to be attached
FailCount.description_zh: 绑定密钥对失败的实例总数量

items.description_en: The set of results for successful or failed key pair attachments
items.description_zh: 绑定密钥对成功或失败的结果集合

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the key pair is successfully attached. Valid values:

true: The key pair is successfully attached.

false: The key pair failed to be attached
Success.description_zh:
绑定密钥对是否成功。可能值：

true：绑定密钥对成功。

false：绑定密钥对失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of instances to which the key pair is attached
TotalCount.description_zh: 绑定密钥对的实例总数量
